capabilities: Publish notes to a Pagecord blog as posts or drafts
Update existing posts tracked via frontmatter tokens
Upload embedded images and PDFs to Pagecord
Read post metadata like title, slug, tags, and locale from frontmatter
Publish to multiple configured Pagecord blogs
extras: Publishing requires an account and API key from the Pagecord service; the plugin also writes its own frontmatter fields (pagecord_token, pagecord_attachments, etc.) to the note.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes to an external Pagecord blog, including handling images, PDFs, and post updates.
summary: Publishing plugin that sends Obsidian notes to a Pagecord blog as posts or drafts, uploading embedded images and PDFs.
